item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-6e6a425cde098cdd","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The World Bank's 2023 DRC Country Climate and Development Report identified stronger, more resilient institutions, conflict and fragility management, substantial investment, resilient infrastructure, food security, energy access, governance, social inclusion, and human-capital improvements as necessary for climate-resilient development. It estimated that unchanged climate trends could cost 4.7%–12.9% of GDP by 2050 and push an additional 16 million people into poverty under the most pessimistic scenario.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The report was published in November 2023 and concerns the DRC's policy and institutional requirements during the target period, but its quantified projections extend to 2050.","ruler_attribution":"The report evaluates national conditions and required policy action; these findings do not by themselves establish that Tshisekedi personally enacted or implemented the recommended measures.","limitations":["Country-level diagnostic rather than a direct assessment of presidential conduct.","Projected future impacts are not 2023 outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6e6a425cde098cdd","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The World Bank report set out four urgent action areas for the DRC: climate-smart mining, hydropower, forest preservation and landscape management; climate-smart agriculture and food security; climate-resilient transport and cities, digital access and basic services; and improved governance, poverty reduction, social inclusion and security. It estimated initial public adaptation investments of about $10.9 billion by 2050.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.6","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Published in November 2023; the action areas and investment estimate are forward-looking recommendations.","ruler_attribution":"The report presents an external diagnostic and recommended priorities, not evidence that Tshisekedi adopted, funded, or executed them.","limitations":["Recommendations and estimated needs are not proof of implementation.","The investment estimate covers a period through 2050."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f5de8aa767712d49","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The DRC, Zambia and United States signed a trilateral memorandum of understanding to develop an integrated electric-vehicle battery value chain from mineral extraction through assembly, building on existing DRC-Zambia cooperation and targeting critical minerals and low-carbon industrial development.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The agreement was signed in December 2022 and was under discussion during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the DRC's participation to its government but does not identify Tshisekedi's personal decision, resources, or implementation role.","limitations":["The MOU predates most of the target year.","The source describes an agreement, not completed outputs."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f5de8aa767712d49","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The EV-battery MOU was nonbinding, contained no concrete action plan, technological-transfer commitments, or specified U.S. financial commitments, and stated that activities depended on fund availability; the analysis therefore characterized it as primarily a political-signaling and first-step instrument whose implementation was not guaranteed.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.7","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The assessment was published in August 2023 and evaluates the agreement's status during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The implementation limitation concerns the trilateral arrangement and DRC government capacity; it does not establish that Tshisekedi personally caused the vagueness or failed to implement it.","limitations":["Analyst assessment rather than an audit of Tshisekedi's personal conduct.","No outcome data are provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f5de8aa767712d49","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The analysis reported that the DRC government was reviewing and renegotiating cobalt and copper mining deals with China, which could increase the DRC's negotiating agency, but warned that the December 2023 presidential election created risks of political interference and conflicts of interest; it recommended technical expertise, cost-benefit analysis, clear benchmarks and oversight for MOU execution.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","5B.7","7B.3","7B.9","8B.4","8B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The review, renegotiation and election-related risks were discussed in August 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the review to the DRC government but does not document Tshisekedi's personal role, conflicts, or response to the recommendations.","limitations":["The source reports risks and recommendations rather than confirmed presidential misconduct or completed reforms.","No specific contract outcome is stated."]},{"source_id":"SRC-de55bc5417bfe18c","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"The supplied theses.fr page identifies a 2023 doctoral thesis on the intellectual framework of social Catholicism confronting the weak state in the DRC between 1990 and 2018, but the extracted page contains catalogue metadata and no substantive findings about 2023 or Tshisekedi.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The thesis concerns 1990–2018, outside or largely before the target period.","ruler_attribution":"No substantive attribution to Tshisekedi is present in the supplied units.","limitations":["Only catalogue metadata were supplied; the thesis text and findings are absent.","The stated research period ends in 2018."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b2562d6adff0d91","start_unit":1,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal listed DRC climate resources including the DRC Country Climate and Development Report, a climate-risk country profile, the 2021 revised Nationally Determined Contribution, the 2015 national communication, and national laws on nature protection and electricity.","question_ids":["1B.9","5B.7","5B.10","6B.5","8B.1"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The portal was available during the target period but lists documents from multiple years.","ruler_attribution":"The portal catalogs national and World Bank materials; listing them does not show that Tshisekedi enacted, funded, or enforced the associated safeguards or policies.","limitations":["A resource index, not an evaluation of implementation.","Most listed documents predate 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d7087135024f5371","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi was identified as President of the DRC in a 27 February 2023 high-level segment of the UN Human Rights Council.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly within the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The UN Web TV record establishes his office and appearance but supplies no substantive statement or decision.","limitations":["No speech transcript or policy content is included in the supplied units."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8b0c230156851363","start_unit":3,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The official presidential programme, initiated by Tshisekedi and prepared by an expert team under his cabinet's supervision, was converted from the CACH programme into a government programme and articulated 20 pillars covering pacification, reconciliation, democracy, rule of law, anti-corruption, macroeconomic stability, education, universal health coverage, employment, women and youth, business, climate, electricity, water, infrastructure, agriculture, diversification, mining, tourism and poverty reduction.","question_ids":["3B.9","4B.10","5B.1","5B.6","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The official programme was available during 2023, though the supplied page does not give its original adoption date.","ruler_attribution":"The Presidency expressly attributes the programme's initiative to Tshisekedi and its preparation to an expert team supervised by his cabinet.","limitations":["The programme establishes stated priorities, not execution or outcomes.","The page labels the programme as having 20 pillars while also describing conversion to a 15-pillar government programme; the supplied text does not resolve the institutional timing."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2085e4ebd4fd46c1","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"CENI declared Tshisekedi the winner of the December 2023 election with over 70% of the vote, but opposition candidates and citizens disputed the result, and observers documented 5,402 significant polling-station irregularities, late opening at two-thirds of stations, and procedural compliance at only 57% of stations.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","4B.6","4B.10","7B.1","7B.2","7B.7","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The election occurred in December 2023; the assessment was published in February 2024 and reports contemporaneous findings.","ruler_attribution":"The irregularities concern the election administered under Tshisekedi's presidency; the supplied source does not prove that he personally ordered specific irregularities.","limitations":["The source reports allegations and observer findings rather than a final judicial determination.","The article was published after the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2085e4ebd4fd46c1","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"CENI announced 44 million registered voters but did not provide the voter register for public review and verification, declined AU and UN offers to audit the electoral roll, used a five-day internal audit, and rejected calls for an independent audit.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","4B.6","4B.10","7B.6","7B.7","8B.5","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"These actions concerned the 2023 electoral process.","ruler_attribution":"The documented decisions are attributed to CENI; the source does not establish Tshisekedi's personal instruction or knowledge, though they occurred under his administration.","limitations":["Institutional attribution is to CENI, not directly to the president.","The article was published in 2024."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2085e4ebd4fd46c1","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The article reported that few SADC electoral-reform recommendations from the 2018 elections were implemented by CENI or the government before the December 2023 polls, and that persistent allegations of irregularity, fraud and political manipulation in 2018 and 2023 eroded trust in electoral processes and democratic institutions.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.6","4B.10","7B.2","7B.6","7B.10","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The reported lack of reform implementation is assessed before the December 2023 election.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes nonimplementation to CENI or the government collectively; it does not isolate Tshisekedi's personal responsibility.","limitations":["The source does not list which recommendations were or were not implemented.","The article is a post-election assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2085e4ebd4fd46c1","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Voting did not occur in Rutshuru and Masisi because of armed-group control, disenfranchising hundreds of thousands of citizens during the 2023 elections; the article linked this exclusion to possible civil unrest and instability and called for dialogue, electoral reform and improved security.","question_ids":["2B.10","3B.7","3B.9","3B.10","4B.1","4B.7","4B.10","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The non-voting and disenfranchisement occurred during the 2023 elections.","ruler_attribution":"The exclusion resulted from insecurity and armed-group control; the source calls on Tshisekedi to collaborate on future reforms but does not establish personal causation.","limitations":["No evidence is supplied about specific presidential decisions regarding the affected territories.","The number of disenfranchised citizens is described as hundreds of thousands, not precisely quantified."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0c4082d2afc8f031","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"A 2023 peer-reviewed article reported that some Congolese respondents and commentators derided Tshisekedi's extensive foreign travel as 'travel-mania' and viewed the trips as serving his political health and diplomatic contacts more than delivering peace and material benefits, arguing that internal efforts were needed first.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.10","5B.1","5B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published 22 June 2023, with analysis of Tshisekedi's presidency and diplomatic travel.","ruler_attribution":"The assessment is based on reported respondent and public perceptions, not an independent finding that the trips had no policy value.","limitations":["The supplied abstract gives no sample size, methodology details, or trip-by-trip outcomes.","It is an interpretive academic assessment rather than an administrative audit."]},{"source_id":"SRC-150d33a93b8bc8f9","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The French ISS assessment reported that CENI proclaimed Tshisekedi winner of the December 2023 election with more than 70% of votes, while observers documented 5,402 significant irregularities, two-thirds of polling stations opened late, only 57% followed procedures, and CENI withheld the voter register from review and rejected independent audit requests.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","4B.6","4B.10","7B.6","7B.7","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The facts concern the December 2023 election; the article was published in February 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The reported conduct is primarily attributed to CENI and electoral observers; it occurred during Tshisekedi's presidency but is not shown to be personally directed by him.","limitations":["This is a parallel French-language version of the ISS assessment and does not add independent evidence to the English account.","The article reports allegations and observer findings rather than a final court ruling."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b7405b6660df2990","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"During renewed fighting in eastern DRC in October–November 2023, more than 450,000 people were displaced in North Kivu, bringing national displacement to a record 6.9 million; aid access was limited in Masisi and Rutshuru, hate speech and misinformation were spreading, and child recruitment and risks of sexual violence increased.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.5","2B.10","3B.6","3B.7","3B.9","3B.10","6B.3","6B.6","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The displacement escalation and humanitarian assessment are directly within late 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The ICRC describes conflict conditions involving M23, the armed forces and Wazalendo; it does not allocate personal responsibility to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source is a humanitarian situation report, not a presidential performance evaluation.","It does not establish which protective decisions were available to or taken by Tshisekedi."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b7405b6660df2990","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"After obtaining security guarantees, the ICRC crossed front lines and provided food and tarpaulins to more than 22,000 people in Bwito, Rutshuru, while donated medicines and medical supplies were expected to enable treatment for more than 150,000 people in regional health centres; the ICRC continued dialogue with conflict parties to promote compliance with the rules of war.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.5","2B.7","3B.7","3B.9","6B.2","6B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The assistance was delivered in November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The actions are those of the ICRC and donors; the passage does not show Tshisekedi's funding, authorization, or implementation role.","limitations":["Humanitarian organization outputs cannot be attributed to the ruler without evidence of state involvement.","The source does not report government accountability or remedy for violations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0081df6b98b2af46","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Since the start of 2023, fighting in North Kivu displaced about 600,000 people; only 18% of those displaced in the preceding six months lived in camps or shelters, while 82% stayed with host families. In Oicha, shelters intended for 5,700 people held about 7,200, while an estimated 165,000 displaced people depended on local communities.","question_ids":["2B.10","3B.6","3B.7","3B.9","3B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The displacement figures and conditions cover the first half and mid-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The figures describe conflict and humanitarian conditions; they do not identify Tshisekedi's personal decisions or causal responsibility.","limitations":["The source does not provide national government budget or policy data.","Population estimates are attributed to UN or local committees."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0081df6b98b2af46","start_unit":6,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"During the first half of 2023, ICRC and DRC Red Cross operations reunited 108 children with families, organized 82,639 calls for separated relatives, reached 15,722 children with recruitment-prevention activities, provided food or household assistance to tens of thousands, and supported health, water and sanitation services for displaced and host communities across North and South Kivu.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The operational results are explicitly for the first half of 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These are ICRC and DRC Red Cross activities; the source does not establish that Tshisekedi's government directed or funded them.","limitations":["The source records humanitarian outputs, not national government performance.","Some activities were implemented with partners and cannot be assigned to the president."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-1e0590ea270c54bf"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied materials contain substantial country-level, institutional and humanitarian evidence but limited direct evidence of Tshisekedi's personal orders, budgets, appointments, enforcement decisions, or corrective actions.","The two ISS documents are parallel English and French versions of the same assessment; their facts were not treated as independent corroboration.","Several sources were published after 2023 while describing 2023 events; period fit is stated for each record.","No source supplied material evidence concerning nuclear weapons, proliferation controls, AI, cyber, biological safeguards, or other existential-risk governance specific to Tshisekedi."]}
